recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-13267 follow-up is needed in core source unless a future Security Work Group decision revisits the broader Provenance retrieval guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-13267 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Security issue asking the Security and Privacy module page to describe how a client queries for resources and asks that matching Provenance records be returned, pointing to Search `_revinclude` guidance.
initial_application: Commit 84f8086d21facb3551bfb28481156250510ae48b explicitly listed GF#13267 and added the Provenance use case to source/secpriv-module.html, including reverse include and `?_revinclude=Provenance:target`. Later QA/editorial commits retained the guidance while correcting wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml keeps secpriv-module.html in the current build scope. source/search.html defines `_revinclude` for reverse-link inclusion and shows `MedicationRequest?_revinclude=Provenance:target`; the Provenance target search parameter is active. FHIR-22103 later clarified related reference-search and `_revinclude` mechanics but did not supersede this module guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current module page already satisfies the Jira request: it has a Provenance use case for returning Provenance records with query results, gives the `Provenance:target` parameter, and links to the Search page.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue clarified versioned-reference search and `_revinclude` documentation generally; it supports rather than supersedes the current Provenance retrieval guidance.
